# Shell completion inventory: one command per non-comment line.
# Use a shipped completion for each command and shell when available.
# Generate only missing assets. Debian batcat-to-bat wrappers are the adapter
# exception. Generator adapters live in bootstrap/scripts/install-shell-completions.sh.
# Linux receives Bash and Zsh assets; macOS receives Zsh assets only.
#
# Readers: install-shell-completions.sh (install/check/list), uninstall.sh
# (through `list`), the 55 and 60 hooks (hashes), and run-smoke-tests.sh.
# Generated files carry an ownership marker. Removing a command or detecting
# a native replacement makes install prune its marked files. Check reports
# them as stale; list includes existing owned files until they are pruned.

uv
uvx
golangci-lint
dlv
ruff
chezmoi
mise
bat
